shared_elements: large flat stone slab carved in low relief
figures shown in profile facing sideways
horizontal band of repeated pattern near an edge
raised outlined forms against a plain sunken ground
hand/limb and elongated linear details worked in shallow carving
justification: Both are shallow relief carvings on a broad flat stone face, with profile-oriented figures set against a plain ground and at least one horizontal band of repeated pattern crossing the field. But A shows finely modelled, elaborately detailed human figures in a single tall scene, whereas B is a schematic, blocky monolith stacked with animal forms in several loosely stacked zones — the rendering, subject matter and format have little in common beyond the generic technique.
